TRAINERLOOP · FOCUS

One good ride.

Production app migration to the selected Focus design. Today → Workouts → Preview → Player → Completion → History → Session detail. Today’s avatar opens Profile; equipment opens Devices. Back returns from detail screens, and Play begins recording.

Native Compose screenshots rendered with Roborazzi, then visually inspected. Fixtures include dark mode, loading/errors, empty states, landscape, and enlarged text. Long screens scroll; these captures show the visible viewport. Device connectivity and integrations use deterministic fixtures. The workout overflow menu is checked through Compose interaction assertions; its popup window is omitted because the host renderer cropped the wrong window.

Design specification and verification notes · Interactive app flow documentation
